==1st Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
!width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|Fortunately for Link, a medicine woman lives up here in the heights of Death Mountain.  If you have already shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, she will sell you the {{im/loz|Item|2nd Potion}} for 68 rupees or the {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees.
|width="24%"|"Spectacle Rock is an entrance to [[The Legend of Zelda/Underworld/Quest 1/Dungeon 9|death]]."  Bomb the south side of the left rock to reveal the entrance.
|width="24%"|
|width="24%"|By bombing the flat part of the north wall on the right side, you will uncover an entrance to a cave, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|-
! 2
|If you bomb the right end of the north wall, a cave entrance will appear, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|
|Avoiding the rocks, bomb the flat section of the north wall to reveal a cave which contains the Money Making Game inside.
|
|-
! 3
|One of these {{im/loz|Enemy|Armoses}} is hiding a secret.  If you touch and wake up the right most Armos in the top row, he will reveal the {{im/loz|Item|Power Bracelet}}, which you need in order to make use of the secret Overworld passages.
|The shop in the cave sells (the ability to use) {{im/loz|Item|Arrows}} for 80 rupees, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 130 rupees, and a set of 4 {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} for 20 rupees.
|If you bomb the north wall directly over the southern path, you will reveal a hidden shop that sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 rupees, and an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 rupees.
! rowspan="2" | See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|Section 3]]
|-

! See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|Section 6]]

==2nd Quest==
{| {{prettytable}}
! || A || B || C || D
|-
!width="4%" | 1
|width="24%"|Fortunately for Link, a medicine woman lives up here in the heights of Death Mountain.  If you have already shown her the {{im/loz|Item|Letter}}, she will sell you the {{im/loz|Item|2nd Potion}} for 68 rupees or the {{im/loz|Item|Water of Life}} for 40 rupees.
|width="24%"|
|width="24%"|Blowing on the {{im/loz|Item|Whistle}} in this area will reveal a staircase that you can descend and obtain a valuable {{im/loz|Item|Heart Container}}.
|width="24%"|By bombing the flat part of the north wall on the right side, you will uncover an entrance to a cave, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|-
! 2
|If you bomb the right end of the north wall, a cave entrance will appear, but the man inside will charge you 20 rupees for repairs.
|Bomb the flat part of the north wall to reveal an otherwise regular shop which sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 160 rupees, a {{im/loz|Item|Key}} for 100 rupees, or the {{im/loz|Item|Blue Candle}} for 60 rupees.
|Avoiding the rocks, bomb the flat section of the north wall to reveal a cave which contains the Money Making Game inside.
|
|-
! 3
|One of these {{im/loz|Enemy|Armoses}} is hiding a secret.  If you touch and wake up the right most Armos in the top row, he will reveal the {{im/loz|Item|Power Bracelet}}, which you need in order to make use of the secret Overworld passages.
|The shop in the cave sells (the ability to use) {{im/loz|Item|Arrows}} for 80 rupees, the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 130 rupees, and a set of 4 {{im/loz|Item|Bombs}} for 20 rupees.
|If you bomb the north wall directly over the southern path, you will reveal a hidden shop that sells the {{im/loz|Item|Magical Shield}} for 90 rupees, {{im/loz|Item|Monster Bait}} for 100 rupees, and an ordinary {{im/loz|Item|Heart}} for 10 rupees.
! rowspan="2" | See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 3|Section 3]]
|-
! 4
! See [[The Legend of Zelda/Overworld/Hyrule 6|Section 6]]
|
|
|}
